request.heading: Reset your password
request.subline: Enter your email and we'll send you a link.

emailSent.heading: Check your email
emailSent.body: If there is an account for {email}, we've sent a link to reset your password. It works for 1 hour.

confirmPassword.label: Confirm new password
confirmPassword.mismatch: The passwords don't match. Type the same password in both boxes.

linkExpired.heading: This link has expired
linkExpired.body: Reset links work for 1 hour and only once. Request a new one.

success.heading: Password updated
success.body: You can now log in with your new password.
